experimental_system.chemistry: decanoic acid:decanol 2:1 vesicles in phosphate buffer, following the Sokolskyi–Baum FR chemistry as the reference system
experimental_system.parent_batch_per_independent_unit: 2.4 mL physically separate parent population incubated 24 h before intervention; scale is fixed for the prospective experiment and is not pooled across independent units
experimental_system.resuspension: five complete aspiration/dispense cycles with a sterile large-volume pipette immediately before arm split
experimental_system.arm_split: each parent batch is split into control, do(m), sham and assay reserve before any active manipulation

independent_unit.definition: one physically separate parent vesicle population/batch generated, incubated and handled independently from all other parent populations, then split within-unit across control, do(m) and sham
not_independent: the three arms created from the same parent
independent_unit.exclusion_rule: no outcome-based exclusion; only preregistered catastrophic contamination, lost sample, complete instrument failure, or documented protocol violation before decoding

X.definition: pre-intervention present-state vector measured on the common parent immediately before arm split; it excludes all DLS variables used to define m
X.normalization: for each independent unit and response dimension, the pre-intervention value is normalized to 1.0 and future R is expressed relative to that same anchor
X.rule: DLS Z-average, DLS PDI and any direct m-derived statistic are forbidden from X
X.matching: within-parent split gives exact biological pairing before manipulation; non-target chemistry and handling must also pass the preregistered tolerances

m.definition: physical seed-structure trace carried by the parental vesicle population, operationalized as the DLS size distribution and not as turbidity
m.control: standard resuspended parental material; no membrane extrusion
m.operator: after the common five-cycle resuspension, pass the do(m) aliquot 11 times through a 100 nm track-etched polycarbonate membrane in a hand-held mini-extruder; use the same buffer, apparatus family, temperature window, elapsed handling window and final collection side as the sham

target_levels.do(m): 100 nm extrusion reset; population-level median post-operator Z-average must be 80–150 nm and median PDI <= 0.25
target_levels.sham: 11 passes through a 5 µm track-etched polycarbonate membrane using the identical syringe/extruder sequence; population-level median Z-average change relative to control must be <=10% and absolute median PDI change <=0.05

m.manipulation_fidelity: all units remain in intention-to-treat analysis. Failure of the population-level do(m) or sham fidelity criterion makes the strict causal qualification fail; it does not authorize a post-hoc operator change.
m.rationale: 100 nm extrusion is a direct physical reset of vesicle size structure. It does not replace feeding with preformed vesicles and therefore avoids the FR→UR architecture change.

A_architecture.definition: non-target experimental architecture held equal across arms

Theta.definition: future amphiphile-feed challenges applied identically to control, do(m) and sham after intervention
Theta.common_rules: 80 µL parent-arm transfer into a 200 µL final challenge volume; use the same 1 M 2:1 decanoic acid:decanol stock; buffer volume is adjusted only to keep final volume constant
Theta.order: challenge positions randomized within plate/block; all three arms from one parent remain in the same block

R.definition: future response after do(m) and challenge, measured in four preregistered dimensions
R.technical_replication: technical readout replicates are averaged within the parent×arm×challenge cell before P_acc; they never increase n
R.blinding: raw wells carry randomized codes; arm identity is withheld from the analyst until the immutable analysis table and exclusions are frozen

P_acc.threshold_source: prospective biological SESOI fixed as relative changes; no test-data calibration permitted
P_acc.sham_tolerance_interpretation: no independent unit may differ from its control by more than 3 of the 48 accessibility cells under sham handling

SESOI_and_power.note: power calculation is planning only; final inference uses the preregistered paired bootstrap from PACC-INT-CHALLENGE-V1

decision_rule.causal_qualified: all matching flags true; n analyzable >=40; do(m) fidelity passes; sham structural fidelity passes; P_acc sham max-absolute tolerance passes
decision_rule.section_XIV_condition_9_local_branch_mea: satisfied locally if causal_qualified is true, regardless of the sign or size of Delta_P_acc
decision_rule.direct_INV_A_support: causal_qualified AND mean Delta_P_acc <= -0.08 AND paired bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0
decision_rule.direct_INV_A_non_support: causal_qualified but the preregistered support rule is not met
decision_rule.unqualified: any strict matching, sham, intervention-fidelity or n>=40 gate fails; descriptive estimates are still published

randomization_and_blinding.randomization_seed: generated and committed in the public preregistration before execution
randomization_and_blinding.arm_assignment: within-parent randomized label mapping; physical control/do/sham processing follows the concealed map
randomization_and_blinding.plate_blocking: parent population is the block; all arms and challenge doses remain represented within the same block
randomization_and_blinding.analysis_blinding: decode only after raw-data freeze, exclusion log freeze and SHA-256 of the analysis-ready table

required_before_execution: public OSF registration URL or equivalent immutable registration identifier
SHA-256 of this protocol JSON and its analysis script recorded in that registration
preregistration_gate.reason: public registration identifier is not yet attached; no new test data may be acquired before that step
